name: horas-complementares
description: Controle de horas complementares da turma de Psicologia — Técnicas de Observação

scripts.banco:ver: wrangler d1 execute horas-complementares --remote --command "SELECT 'usuarios' AS tabela, COUNT(*) AS registros FROM usuarios UNION ALL SELECT 'cursos' AS tabela, COUNT(*) AS registros FROM cursos UNION ALL SELECT 'categorias' AS tabela, COUNT(*) AS registros FROM categorias UNION ALL SELECT 'regras_categoria' AS tabela, COUNT(*) AS registros FROM regras_categoria UNION ALL SELECT 'coordenacoes' AS tabela, COUNT(*) AS registros FROM coordenacoes UNION ALL SELECT 'turmas' AS tabela, COUNT(*) AS registros FROM turmas UNION ALL SELECT 'atividades' AS tabela, COUNT(*) AS registros FROM atividades UNION ALL SELECT 'aulas' AS tabela, COUNT(*) AS registros FROM aulas UNION ALL SELECT 'materiais' AS tabela, COUNT(*) AS registros FROM materiais UNION ALL SELECT 'tarefas' AS tabela, COUNT(*) AS registros FROM tarefas UNION ALL SELECT 'entregas' AS tabela, COUNT(*) AS registros FROM entregas UNION ALL SELECT 'arquivos' AS tabela, COUNT(*) AS registros FROM arquivos UNION ALL SELECT 'convites' AS tabela, COUNT(*) AS registros FROM convites UNION ALL SELECT 'chaves_api' AS tabela, COUNT(*) AS registros FROM chaves_api UNION ALL SELECT 'sessoes' AS tabela, COUNT(*) AS registros FROM sessoes"
